**[P2] Flush in-flight exports on worker re-entry**

The worker removes a record from `_pending` before calling `_export()`. If that callback re-enters a sampled-in invocation end that emits no new record, this guard returns without requesting a flush, leaving the just-exported snapshot buffered and vulnerable to loss when Lambda freezes the environment. Distinguish export re-entry from flush re-entry—for example, request a flush when no flush is currently in flight, or when new pending work exists—and add a no-emission re-entry test.
